about: Checkpoint 8 (WHETHER) policy. DEMO / TEAM pacing settings chosen for the hackathon - NOT official Hoichoi numbers (the problem statement names the rules - max breaks per hour, minimum gap, ad load % - but gives no values). Change them here at any time; no code changes needed.

pacing.max_breaks_per_video_note: optional override (null = off). When set, it is used instead of max_breaks_per_hour.
pacing.rounding_note: allowed breaks = ceil(duration_hours x max_breaks_per_hour), then capped by the ad-load rule. Options: ceil | nearest | floor.
pacing.short_video_buffer_note: no-break buffers at the start/end = min(no_break_first/last_sec, this % of the video) so short clips can still get breaks

quality_gate.loud_music_rule: reject if any quieter candidate passes the gate, otherwise score x 0.5
quality_gate.avoid_breaks_next_to_sensitive_note: true = never break next to a death/violence/illness scene; 'prefer' = allowed but the WHERE score is multiplied by sensitive_penalty; false = ignore. Brand safety (checkpoint 9 negative_contexts hard block) is enforced in every mode.

selection.prefer: highest total WHERE score of the chosen breaks
